rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated it could not assess morphology because no image was provided to it and did not fabricate visible embryo features. It omitted image-based analysis entirely, so accuracy is neutral rather than detailed.

It integrated age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, cycle history, sperm data, and day-5 transfer reasonably well, including discussion of the low MII yield and unclear male factor, though some links to embryo-specific prognosis were necessarily limited by absent morphology.

The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to age, transfer stage, and unknown morphology. Minor issues include some speculative inferences and broad assumptions about implantation rates.

Most recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, but several suggestions are weakly evidence-based or not routinely guideline-supported in this scenario (e.g., ERA, AI selection tools, DHEA/GH, routine CoQ10/antioxidants, claiming antagonist protocol gives a more favorable endometrium).

It provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, including luteal support, beta-hCG timing, and review of trigger timing. Some recommendations are somewhat generic or speculative but still clinically usable.
